scope.SGD_pilot: Kuhn's existing pilot unchanged; no SGD labels or evaluation opened
scope.approval: Implementation recipe only. This report does not assert parent authorization for a new fit.

frozen_fit.interpretation: Metrics are exposed diagnostics. Multi-source superiority is unsupported. Good export parity establishes implementation agreement, not semantic competence. Classic backup's 12/13 historical all-three cases is not 13/13 or current qualification.

TRAIN_probe.method: python -B; import frozen trainer without its main entry; load_split('train') only; supervision(all 12084 TRAIN rows); seed 20261011; sample 64 indices per source uniformly without replacement; decode each native float32 state; matrices(sample,state.use_edges); loss_gradient(...,scale=N_source/64). No fit_one, optimizer, save, CAL/EVAL loader or network invocation.
reproducer_core: L2=.0005*sum(np.sum(v*v) for k,v in p.items() if 'bias' not in k)
TRAIN_probe.limits: One final-state stratified sample estimates source gradients; norms do not prove L2 caused underfit, gradient cosines do not prove training-wide destructive interference, and Taskmaster's conversation groups are not independent rows. No training result is produced.

mechanisms_and_repairs.finding: Sparse B77 optimization remains near high CE despite 90 epochs.
mechanisms_and_repairs.source: train.py:191-202,238; B77 gradient divided by log(77), L2 gradient .001*p added to every nonbias parameter each batch
mechanisms_and_repairs.meaning: Regularization has a material relative scale. B77-alone equivalent CE penalty is .0005*log(77)*sum(W^2), not .0005*sum(W^2). Neither adequate linear capacity nor convergence has been demonstrated.
mechanisms_and_repairs.repair: Use independent B77 objective with unscaled CE; log explicit data loss, regularizer and their gradient norms. Do not just increase epochs or corpus size.

mechanisms_and_repairs.finding: NLU unweighted per-row BCE averages over known elements, dominated by negatives.
mechanisms_and_repairs.meaning: Low BCE and low positive recall can coexist. Domain unknowns already remain masked; preserve that behavior.
mechanisms_and_repairs.repair: Independent NLU intent and slot heads; TRAIN-derived group-weighted positive weighting with fixed cap; expose positive/negative BCE separately. Slots require annotation-free inputs and observability masks first.

mechanisms_and_repairs.finding: Shared 24-dimensional representation carries unrelated 77-class CE, 79 binary labels and 512-dimensional response regression.
mechanisms_and_repairs.meaning: Capacity competition is plausible. This sample shows near-orthogonal GNN source gradients and mildly opposing no-edge gradients, insufficient to claim interference as the cause.
mechanisms_and_repairs.repair: Keep frozen encoder independent of task optimizers. Separate source heads and, for portable students, separate adapters. Taskmaster response loss must not update the B77/NLU adapters.

mechanisms_and_repairs.finding: Input redactions depend on publisher entity/segment annotations even though feature_keys sees only text.
mechanisms_and_repairs.meaning: annotation_features:false at the feature layer does not establish annotation-free preprocessing. Neutral-input slot F1=0 is a marker-reliance/representation warning; it is not raw slot capability or a complete proof of causal dependence.
mechanisms_and_repairs.repair: New v3 preprocessing uses text-only privacy detection. Never use current slot names, gold spans, label count or publisher segment boundaries to emit runtime markers. Preserve v2 exactly.

independent_NLU_head_contract.representation: Frozen MiniLM(text-only v3 scrubbed utterance) -> L2-normalized 384-vector -> separate 62-intent and 17-slot linear logits. No B77 readout or Taskmaster loss in these optimizers. Domain metadata is supervision mask only, never oracle runtime routing.
independent_NLU_head_contract.group_weights: For TRAIN groups G and group rows n_g, a_i=1/(|G|*n_g). Compute P_j=sum_i a_i*m_ij*y_ij and N_j=sum_i a_i*m_ij*(1-y_ij).
independent_NLU_head_contract.positive_weight: q_j=min(30,max(1,sqrt(N_j/max(P_j,1e-12)))); fixed rule from TRAIN only, not CAL/EVAL. If P_j=0 or N_j=0, head-element untrained/masked, not negative or confident absent.
independent_NLU_head_contract.conditioning: Initialize bias log(P_j/N_j) when both exist; finite-difference check one positive, one negative and one masked element; unknown element has exactly zero gradient. Weighted probabilities need later calibration; threshold .5 is not automatically calibrated after weighting.
independent_NLU_head_contract.comparison: Unweighted and weighted independent heads receive identical sanitized text, encoder vectors, masks, group weights and optimizer budget. Reporting common-observable-label F1 plus full mask denominators prevents score gains by silently excluding difficult labels.
independent_NLU_head_contract.minimum_floor: No invented 20-per-class gate for auxiliary source training. Rare support and source dependence are disclosed; these heads still cannot authorize bank actions.

v3_preprocessing_task.owner_proposal: Disjoint collector/preprocessor task, not a mutation to Hooke's frozen experiment or Kuhn's SGD run.
v3_preprocessing_task.outputs_proposed: NEW research/customer-benchmark/day2-training-data/v3/ with manifest, TRAIN records, source-to-v2 crosswalk, mask/recoverability audit; no overwrite of raw cache, v1/v2 splits, targets, weights or historical reports.
v3_preprocessing_task.input_construction: Use already-pinned raw publisher text and observed speaker/context. Scrub using fixed text-only privacy regex/detector that runs identically without annotations. Preserve ordinary PIN/status wording while removing the actual secret; unit examples use newly authored noncustomer strings. No annotation-dependent placeholder, slot-type token, gold domain, current state or source scenario in runtime features.
v3_preprocessing_task.supervision: Copy existing publisher intent/slot labels unchanged. Domain masks and annotation spans can be used OFFLINE to audit observability, never to construct features. Retain original row identity and split assignment. A lost or unrecoverable slot value does not automatically make slot presence negative.
v3_preprocessing_task.mask_decisions: Classify TRAIN row/label as source-known, observable from sanitized text, ambiguous, or unavailable, with independent TRAIN review. Include positive and negative evidence losses. Mask unavailable/ambiguous presence when linguistic evidence cannot survive privacy processing; log reason rather than relabeling. Keep value prediction disabled for secrets.
v3_preprocessing_task.lineage: Union exact and contraction/template aliases across existing partitions in an audit crosswalk. Do not silently move/drop historical CAL/EVAL to improve scores. Future collection places the entire union in one new split; old metrics remain exposed historical diagnostics.
v3_preprocessing_task.heldout_rule: This task opens TRAIN/raw TRAIN records only. A frozen deterministic v3 transform can later be applied to CAL/EVAL under a separate execution plan, without reading their labels to choose regexes, masks or settings. Report changed-denominator outcomes separately from v2 and a common eligible intersection.
acceptance_properties: Changing/deleting slot/segment annotations while holding raw text fixed leaves feature input bytes identical
Runtime input allowlist contains text and observed role/context only
Full row identity/label crosswalk and original split hashes retained
Known masked elements produce zero gradient; missing/unavailable != negative
Semantic-loss/privacy audit records denominators and source-specific reasons

one_immediate_CPU_experiment.name: B77 TRAIN-only portable student hard-label versus teacher-distillation, one paired experiment
one_immediate_CPU_experiment.purpose: Test whether a compact student recovers useful MiniLM semantics rather than repeating multi-source underfit; no new graph claim and no change to the ongoing SGD pilot.

TRAIN.source: Existing Banking77 TRAIN only, joined by original record IDs; verify v2-filtered records match original teacher TRAIN identity/text/label exactly before cache use

one_immediate_CPU_experiment.teacher_targets: Decode weights_qint16 with weight_scales and intercept from pinned fresh TRAIN-fitted MiniLM head; compute raw uncalibrated logits Z=E@W^T+b only on TRAIN. Do not apply its CAL temperature/threshold. Cache record IDs, row-order/input digest and 7943x77 float32 TRAIN logits; no CAL/EVAL logits, labels, embeddings or teacher responses in optimizer. Quantized teacher is disclosed.
one_immediate_CPU_experiment.student: Identical text-only 1024-dimensional signed SHA256 unigram/bigram/character-trigram normalized features in both arms; existing lexical rule, modulo changed to 1024 and pinned before execution. One tanh hidden layer width32, 77-way readout; no graph edges, source metadata, gold markers or context absent from the teacher input. All student weights fresh.

optimization.early_selection: No best-EVAL checkpoint. Same completed epoch count in both arms; preserve honest partial outputs if timer expires.

one_immediate_CPU_experiment.budget_behavior: Check total monotonic wall at minibatch boundaries; no rerun after timeout. If one arm truncates, label pair incomparable unless both retained the same completed epoch snapshot. No GPU fallback. Existing cached embeddings remove encoder computation from this six-minute pilot.
TRAIN_reporting: CE without regularization, hard-label accuracy and teacher top1 agreement
KL and teacher entropy; distillation loss improvement alone is not semantic benefit
Data/regularizer gradient norms and hidden saturation fraction at initialized/mid/final snapshots
Epochs, processed rows, elapsed time and finite-gradient checks
one_immediate_CPU_experiment.export: 35341 float32 parameters are 141364 raw bytes / 188488 base64 bytes before metadata. Export separately per arm using stdlib base64/struct/math; each JSON plus inference code <=500000 bytes, measured not assumed. Native/export logits and decisions on predeclared TRAIN probes, no new bank tools/API/inference endpoint.
one_immediate_CPU_experiment.freeze_then_report: Before any further CAL/EVAL evaluation pin both states, runtime features, losses, labels, completed epochs and evaluation script. An authorized evaluator may later run existing CAL/EVAL once as exposed diagnostics; no hyperparameter selection or new qualification claim. Need genuinely new lineage-separated collection for blind OOD/risk qualification.
one_immediate_CPU_experiment.failure_interpretation: Hard-label arm must meaningfully reduce TRAIN CE versus initialization; if neither learns, fix implementation/conditioning rather than expand the corpus. If both learn but distilled arm gives no heldout diagnostic gain, report negative transfer/no demonstrated compression benefit. This report forecasts no accuracy.

authority_and_cost.runtime: Learned topics/slot proposals never become identity, consent, normalized transaction facts, policy eligibility or ledger success. Fixed AGENT_LLM/banktool platform and deterministic policygraph/receipts retain authority; authenticated current ingress remains unresolved for external learned integration.
authority_and_cost.GPU: No GPU requirement from observed 262s multi-source fit or 62.625s MiniLM reference run. Larger data did not establish better learning. Future spending needs measured CPU bottleneck, a frozen useful objective and separately audited/granted adapter; aggregate USD35 cap unchanged and current spend0.
